name: Pulsenmore Ltd.
summary: Pulsenmore Ltd. specializes in delivering self-scanning ultrasound technology for distant medical diagnosis and health screening throughout Israel and Europe. Its primary offering is the Pulsenmore at-home ultrasound system, which consists of a portable ultrasound unit that attaches to a patient's smartphone. An accompanying mobile application then securely uploads diagnostic images to the cloud for review. Furthermore, a specialized clinician dashboard enables medical professionals to examine stored video recordings or provide real-time guidance during a scan. Founded in 2014, the company is headquartered in Omer, Israel.
